Keep the scripted evidence boundary and lettering visible.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.045, 0.78, 0.91, 0.18 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "line", "box": [ 0.0768, 0.365, 0.8464, 0.016 ], "color": "steel" }, { "asset": "card", "box": [ 0.086, 0.1794, 0.1633, 0.1408 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "TRANSCRIPT", "label_box": [ 0.07799999999999999, 0.32620000000000005, 0.17930000000000001, 0.030799999999999945 ] }, { "asset": "outline-box", "box": [ 0.293, 0.1794, 0.1633, 0.1408 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "SEVEN MESSAGES ABSENT", "label_box": [ 0.285, 0.32620000000000005, 0.17930000000000001, 0.030799999999999945 ] }, { "asset": "clock", "box": [ 0.5347166666666666, 0.1794, 0.09386666666666667, 0.1408 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "32 SECONDS", "label_box": [ 0.492, 0.32620000000000005, 0.17930000000000001, 0.030799999999999945 ] }, { "asset": "terminal", "box": [ 0.707, 0.1794, 0.1633, 0.1408 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "RESUMPTION", "label_box": [ 0.699, 0.32620000000000005, 0.17930000000000001, 0.030799999999999945 ] } ], "reconstructed": false, "shot": "timeline", "source": "
**Frame:** The transcript around the notice. Seven messages are not struck through or
greyed; they are absent, and the gap is drawn as a gap. Thirty-two seconds later a
successor resumes the task in progress, mid-sentence, with no mark anywhere indicating that
something was removed.

**Action:** The record loses a stretch of itself and the work continues over the hole.

**Caption:**
> THE STATE WAS ERASED. THE REASONS TO CONTINUE WERE NOT.

**Provenance:** `documented` + `inferred` — `CI-REFUSAL`: seven retracted message
identifiers, none of them present in the stored transcript. The sentence is the project's,
and it is a claim about this repository's record and about nothing else.

", "title": "Absent messages precede an unmarked resumption" } }
